What went well today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_success
string-array.item: Finished an important task
Solved a tricky challenge
Stayed calm and kept perspective
Took time for a healthy break

resources.string: What are you leaving behind closed doors?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_let_go
string-array.item: Unfinished emails & tasks until tomorrow
Feeling like I should have done more
Work tension and stressful calls
All open browser tabs in my head

resources.string: What are you proud of today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_proud
string-array.item: Navigated through a demanding day
My patience and steady energy
A small but meaningful step forward
Saying no and protecting my boundaries

resources.string: What do you want to remember tomorrow?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_tomorrow
string-array.item: Start the morning calm and unhurried
Focus on one single thing at a time
Keep clear boundaries between work and rest
Tomorrow is another day; world won\'t end

resources.string: What signal will you give your body and mind now?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_signal
string-array.item: Closing the laptop and leaving the desk
No more Slack, Teams, or inbox today
Changing into comfortable evening clothes
Stepping outside for a short fresh air walk

resources.string: How will you treat yourself this evening?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_evening
string-array.item: A nourishing dinner without looking at screens
A hot shower or relaxing bath
A good book, music, or quiet downtime
Quality time with family or friends

resources.string: What was enough today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_enough
string-array.item: The hours I actually gave it
Doing the important thing, not everything
Showing up even when it was hard
One honest effort, not a perfect one

resources.string: What was the hardest part of today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_hardest
string-array.item: A conversation I was dreading
Starting when I had no motivation
Too many things landing at once
Staying focused through the noise

resources.string: Where did you hold a boundary today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_boundary
string-array.item: I took a real lunch break
I left a message for tomorrow
I said no to one more meeting
I stopped at the time I promised myself

resources.string: What is your body telling you right now?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_body
string-array.item: My shoulders are up by my ears
I have been sitting far too long
I am hungry and running on coffee
It is calmer than my head is

resources.string: What did today teach you?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_learned
string-array.item: Asking sooner would have saved hours
A short break makes the work faster
Not every fire is mine to put out
The first version does not have to be right

resources.string: Which worry stays at your desk?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_worry
string-array.item: A deadline that is still far enough away
What someone might think of my work
A decision I cannot make tonight
A problem that will look smaller tomorrow

resources.string: What are you grateful for today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_grateful
string-array.item: A colleague who covered for me
That the hard part is already done
A quiet hour exactly when I needed one
That I have somewhere to come home to

resources.string: Who made your day easier today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_people
string-array.item: Someone who answered the moment I asked
A colleague who listened without advice
Someone at home who took a task off me
A stranger who was simply kind

resources.string: What stays unfinished, and that is fine?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_unfinished
string-array.item: A task that is not burning today
A reply that can wait until morning
A document nobody is waiting for
The tidy-up I keep postponing

resources.string: What pace did today have?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_pace
string-array.item: Rushed from the first minute
Slow, and that suited me
Uneven — quiet, then all at once
Steady, the way I like it

resources.string: Where did most of your attention go today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_attention
string-array.item: Into one thing I actually cared about
Into messages and notifications
Into other people\'s urgent matters
Into worrying about what comes next

resources.string: What small thing made you smile today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_small_joy
string-array.item: The first coffee of the morning
A message from someone I like
Sunlight coming through the window
Crossing one thing off the list

resources.string: What are you giving yourself permission to drop?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_permission
string-array.item: The need to have everything under control
Comparing myself to everyone else
Replaying one conversation over and over
The feeling that I am behind

resources.string: What gave you energy today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_energy
string-array.item: Work that finally moved forward
A walk or some fresh air
A conversation that went well
Music while I worked

resources.string: What kindness did you show or receive today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_kindness
string-array.item: Someone thanked me and meant it
I helped without being asked
I was patient when I did not feel like it
I was finally gentle with myself too

resources.string: What turned out to be just noise today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_noise
string-array.item: An urgent email that was not urgent
A meeting that could have been a message
A worry that never happened
Half of my notifications

resources.string: How do you want to spend the next hour?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_next_hour
string-array.item: Doing nothing at all, on purpose
Moving my body a little
With someone I barely spoke to today
On something with no purpose whatsoever

resources.string: Where does your free time begin today?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_place
string-array.item: The moment I step away from the desk
On the doorstep, outside
In the kitchen, making dinner
Under the shower

resources.string: Who are you now that work is over?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_role
string-array.item: Someone who is simply at home
A parent, a partner, a friend
Just myself, with no role at all
Someone with a whole evening ahead

resources.string: What helps you slow down tonight?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_slow_down
string-array.item: Putting the phone in another room
Doing one thing at a time
Warmth — a shower, tea, a blanket
Quiet, with nothing playing

resources.string: How is this week treating you so far?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_week
string-array.item: Better than it looked on Monday
Long, and it is not over yet
Full, but in a good way
I have lost track of the days

resources.string: What could you have asked someone for help with?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_ask
string-array.item: Something I have been stuck on for days
A decision I do not want to make alone
Work that is simply too much for one person
Nothing — I asked in time today

resources.string: What from today would you do again tomorrow?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_repeat
string-array.item: Starting with the hardest thing
Taking a break before I needed one
Keeping the morning free of meetings
Finishing on time

resources.string: What would tomorrow-you thank you for right now?

string-array.name: ritual_answers_tomorrow_self
string-array.item: Going to bed at a decent hour
Leaving the desk tidy behind me
Not opening the laptop again tonight
Resting instead of pushing on
